_about: The islands (core/archipelago.gd). Every position is [x, z] in metres from the middle of the spawn island (island 0); the flat ground of every island is height 0. islands: `radius` = where the sand meets the sea (the flat part ends 2 m before it), `grass` = radius of the grass patch, `palms` = palm trees, `scatter` = how many shore rocks and plants it gets (1 = as many as the old single island had; they are only drawn within scatter_range metres of the island's shore). bridges: `from` / `to` = island ids, `price` = points to clear the debris in its middle (it closes again at game over), `kind` = planks | sandbar. spots: things standing on an island, [x, z] from THAT island's middle; `yaw_to` = the island id it faces. spawn_ring: enemies come out of the sea this many metres beyond the shore of the island their prey is on. spawn_arc: metres of shore to either side of its prey within which an enemy comes up (on a big island they would otherwise walk half a minute). far_respawn: an enemy on ANOTHER island than its prey and farther than this from it goes back into the sea and comes out near the players. wade_depth: a player whose feet are this far under the sea surface is carried back to the last island stood on (nobody swims round the debris). Names are the director's to change.
